join: Match the two landings at the same walk height. Place CP10 at (+6, 0, 0) beneath each surveyed span or use a bank abutment where the span ends. Skip or relocate a bearing that conflicts with a road or channel.
title: Glazed crossing span
summary: A continuous six-wide crossing enclosed by recessed blue glass. Pale molded coping, dark mullions and pin lights repeat every six blocks.
